chunks: And he wrote to him: Is it permissible to testify regarding the boundaries when other people from the people of that village come and testify that the boundaries of this estate which the man sold are these? Then is it permissible for this witness, whom he had made witness concerning the estate, while he did not specify the boundaries, to testify to the boundaries based on the statement of those who identified this estate and testified for him? Or is it not permissible for them to testify, while the seller had said to them: Testify to the boundaries when they come to you with them?
So he signed, peace be upon him: Do not testify except on the basis of the owner of the thing and his statement, if Allah wills.

key_terms.الضَّيْعَةِ: the estate or landed property being sold
key_terms.الْحُدُودِ: the boundaries or limits of the property under dispute
key_terms.بِقَوْلِهِ: by his statement; on the basis of what he says
key_terms.صَاحِبِ الشَّيْءِ: the owner of the property or item in question

ai.seo_question: Can a witness testify to the boundaries of a property based on other villagers’ statements?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling about testimony in a property matter, specifically concerning the boundaries of an estate. The Imam عليه السلام instructs that testimony should be based only on the statement of the owner of the property itself, not merely on the identification given by others.
